text: The Toronto Parking Authority ("TPA") Board of Directors ("Board"), at its meeting of August 24, 2018, authorized staff to enter into a Letter of Understanding ("LOU") with the City of Toronto's Shelters, Support and Housing Administration ("SSHA") Division that would enable Toronto Parking Authority to manage the 130-space surface parking lot at 545 Lake Shore Boulevard West ("Carpark 302"). Tied with this approval, the Board authorized expenditure of up to $25,000 in capital improvement and start-up costs. Staff have now had an opportunity to carry out more extensive review and testing at the lot and have determined that additional work over and above that originally identified will be required to address certain safety and operational aspects. Accordingly, expenditure for the capital and start-up improvements in the revised amount of $65,000 is being requested.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Authorized the expenditure in the revised amount of up to $65,000 for capital improvements and start-up costs, generally comprising the supply of revenue control equipment, pavement marking, fencing installation, asphalt and drainage repair, Toronto Parking Authority signage and decommissioning of existing site equipment, required to bring the surface parking facility at 545 Lake Shore Boulevard West to Toronto Parking Authority's standard design and operating specifications.
